thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty incident PD-98765 triggered for service 'shadow-inference' (severity: P1). Auto-page sent to rotation 'oncall-inference'.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-98765 — escalation policy: oncall-inference. Repeats: 3.

marta: I just got woken up by this — looks like the alert is for inference-prod latency but the PD service attached is 'shadow-inference'. Is anyone oncall for shadow right now?

devin: seeing same in infra logs — alerts came from alertmanager rule `inference_high_lat` with label service=inference-prod but PD routing key set to `shadow-inference` in /etc/pagerduty/mappings.yaml on host alert-router-2.

sasha: @marta sorry for the noise. I can look at PD config now — quick check: `pd-service list | grep shadow-inference` shows the service exists and is bound to the wrong escalation policy.

kai: If PD key mismatch, we should silence the shadow service and re-route to inference-prod service key. Quick mitigation: mute PD service to stop noisy pages, then trigger manual page to correct service for responders.

olivia: Agreed. Can someone run the mute? I don't have PD perms from phone.

devin: I'll mute it. Command: ```pd incidents ack PD-98765 --service "shadow-inference" && pd services update shadow-inference --status maintenance``` — doing now.

devin: Done. shadow-inference muted for 30m. Pages should stop.

marta: Thanks. I'm reassigning oncall to inference-prod manually so folks know this is legit. @sasha can you check what changed in routing? Looks like a deploy earlier touched terraform module `pagerduty/mappings` at 03:12 UTC.

sasha: Pulling git history: commit 5c9a2b7 (deployer: olivia) modified `pagerduty/mappings.tf` and accidentally swapped the `inference-prod` and `shadow-inference` service keys. Probably a copy/paste during rollout. 

olivia: ugh — that was me. I was flattening the mapping file to remove duplication. I missed the service_key var. My bad.

kai: Ok, root cause identified: human error in infra change. Immediate fixes: 1) restore correct mapping and roll the change; 2) add a CI check that verifies mapping labels match stack tags; 3) postmortem.

marta: For customers: we saw ~12 duplicate pages to oncall SREs in the wild. No actual customer-facing outage — only alert noise. I'll post an incident summary to #support with short blurb: "false-positive pages due to PD routing misconfiguration; no service degradation observed."

devin: Rolling back the mapping change now: ```git revert 5c9a2b7 && terraform apply -target=module.pagerduty.mappings``` — started.

devin: Rollback applied and mapping restored. Manual test page to inference-prod succeeded and routed to correct rotation.

incident-bot: PD-98765 updated: status -> acknowledged, notes added.

olivia: Sorry again everyone. I'll open a follow-up with checklist and fix pipeline: OPS-2247. Will add a pre-merge validator for PD mappings.

marta: Nice work. Action items: (1) olivia create OPS-2247 + assign; (2) infra add CI check (kai); (3) update runbook with steps to mute PD service (devin). I'll close this thread once OPS-2247 is created and support has the customer note.

olivia: OPS-2247 created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-2247 — assigned to me, eta: EOD.

marta: Closing loop: customers alerted? @support — posting statement now. No impact to inference throughput. Thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
